Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From f6242b354605faff263ca45882b148200915a3f6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Emil Tantilov <emil.s.tantilov@intel.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 16:12:16 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] idpf: fix memory leak in idpf_vport_rel()

Free vport->rx_ptype_lkup in idpf_vport_rel() to avoid leaking memory
during a reset. Reported by kmemleak:

unreferenced object 0xff450acac838a000 (size 4096):
  comm "kworker/u258:5", pid 7732, jiffies 4296830044
  hex dump (first 32 bytes):
    00 00 00 00 00 10 00 00 00 10 00 00 00 00 00 00  ................
    00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 10 00 00 00 00 00 00  ................
  backtrace (crc 3da81902):
    __kmalloc_cache_noprof+0x469/0x7a0
    idpf_send_get_rx_ptype_msg+0x90/0x570 [idpf]
    idpf_init_task+0x1ec/0x8d0 [idpf]
    process_one_work+0x226/0x6d0
    worker_thread+0x19e/0x340
    kthread+0x10f/0x250
    ret_from_fork+0x251/0x2b0
    ret_from_fork_asm+0x1a/0x30

Fixes: 0fe45467a104 ("idpf: add create vport and netdev configuration")
Signed-off-by: Emil Tantilov <emil.s.tantilov@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Aleksandr Loktionov <aleksandr.loktionov@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Madhu Chittim <madhu.chittim@intel.com>
Tested-by: Samuel Salin <Samuel.salin@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Tony Nguyen <anthony.l.nguyen@intel.com>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/intel/idpf/idpf_lib.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/intel/idpf/idpf_lib.c
index a964e0f5891e..04af10cfaa8c 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/intel/idpf/idpf_lib.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/intel/idpf/idpf_lib.c
@@ -1082,6 +1082,8 @@ static void idpf_vport_rel(struct idpf_vport *vport)
 		kfree(adapter->vport_config[idx]->req_qs_chunks);
 		adapter->vport_config[idx]->req_qs_chunks = NULL;
 	}
+	kfree(vport->rx_ptype_lkup);
+	vport->rx_ptype_lkup = NULL;
 	kfree(vport);
 	adapter->num_alloc_vports--;
 }
-- 
2.34.1

The patch fixes a memory leak in the `idpf_vport_rel()` function by freeing the `vport->rx_ptype_lkup` memory that was previously not released.

**Modifications per file:**

- **`drivers/net/ethernet/intel/idpf/idpf_lib.c`** (the only file changed)
  - In the `idpf_vport_rel()` function, added two lines:
    - `kfree(vport->rx_ptype_lkup);` – frees the heap‑allocated `rx_ptype_lkup` buffer.
    - `vport->rx_ptype_lkup = NULL;` – sets the pointer to NULL after freeing.

**Relationships:**  
The sole change is in the cleanup path for a virtual port (vport). The `rx_ptype_lkup` field was allocated during initialization (via `idpf_send_get_rx_ptype_msg`) but was never freed when the vport was destroyed, leading to a memory leak. The patch adds the missing deallocation to prevent the leak, as reported by kmemleak.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
`vport->rx_ptype_lkup = kmalloc(..., GFP_KERNEL);` (inside `idpf_send_get_rx_ptype_msg()`)  
`idpf_vport_rel()` (no matching `kfree(vport->rx_ptype_lkup)` before freeing `vport`)  
Reason: Memory for `rx_ptype_lkup` is allocated during vport initialization but never freed in `idpf_vport_rel()`, causing a memory leak on vport release (e.g., during a reset).

The code statements that fix the bug are:
`kfree(vport->rx_ptype_lkup);`  
`vport->rx_ptype_lkup = NULL;`  
Reason: These lines deallocate the previously allocated memory and clear the pointer to prevent dangling references, eliminating the memory leak.
